scripts.text: My family used to live in Geffen. So I guess it was natural that we studied forging and eventually became Blacksmiths. Then, we finally moved to this town,
scripts.translation: 我家以前住在吉芬。所以学习锻造，最终成为铁匠，对我们来说也是自然而然的事。后来，我们搬到了艾尔帕兰这

scripts.text: My father was a famous blacksmith in Geffen, and he taught me a lot about forging equipment.
scripts.translation: 我父亲是吉芬著名的铁匠，他教了我很多关于装备锻造的知识。

scripts.text: One of the fundamentals is that the success probability of upgrading an item depends on the level of the weapon.
scripts.translation: 其中一个基本原则是，武器的精炼成功率取决于武器等级。

scripts.text: For level 1 weapons, you may upgrade up to + 7 without the risk of breaking the weapon. Level 2 weapons can be upgraded to +6. Level 3 weapons can be upgraded to +5 safely.
scripts.translation: 1级武器可以安全精炼到+7，2级武器可以精炼到+6，3级武器可以安全精炼到+5。

scripts.text: For level 4 weapons, you can upgrade + 4 without too much risk. As for armors, you can upgrade them to +4. But if the upgrade for the equipment fails, it will be destroyed!
scripts.translation: 4级武器可以精炼到+4，风险较小；防具也可以精炼到+4。不过，装备精炼失败就会损坏！

scripts.text: If you get a chance, try to visit my father's workshop here in Al de Baran. If I may say so, he's a pretty talented Blacksmith.
scripts.translation: ..有机会的话，去看看我父亲在艾尔帕兰的工坊吧。不是我自夸，他的锻造手艺真的很出色。

scripts.text: Have you heard that a famous Blacksmith moved here from Geffen?
scripts.translation: 你听说有一位著名的铁匠从吉芬搬到这里了吗？

scripts.text: From what I've heard, he's one of those Blacksmiths that can upgrade your weapons and armor. When you upgrade a weapon, its attack strength is increased.
scripts.translation: 听说，他能精炼武器和防具。武器经过精炼，攻击力就会提高。

scripts.text: For each upgrade level, attack strength increases by 2 for level 1 weapons. On level 2 weapons, 3 attack strength is added.
scripts.translation: 每精炼一级，1级武器的攻击力增加2点，2级武器的攻击力增加3点。

scripts.text: On level 3 weapons, 5 attack strength is added for each level, and for level 4 weapons, 7 attack strength is added for each level.
scripts.translation: 3级武器每级增加5点攻击力，4级武器每级增加7点攻击力。

scripts.text: This Blacksmith's family lives here, since his wife is sick and weak. Because of her condition, she needs to take medicinal herbs that grow near Al de Baran.
scripts.translation: 这位铁匠一家搬来这里，是因为他的妻子体弱多病，需要服用艾尔帕兰附近生长的草药。

scripts.text: They also have a dutiful son who's always helping out with the family business. I'm sure that kid will grow up to become a good Blacksmith like his father.
scripts.translation: 他们还有一个孝顺的儿子，总是帮忙打理家业。我相信那个小孩长大后，会成为像他父亲一样优秀的铁匠。
我真不敢相信竟然存在这么

scripts.text: Well, they're rarely seen in the open market, but boss monsters will drop them by a low chance if you happen to be able to kill them.
scripts.translation: 市面上很少见到，不过打倒Boss魔物后，有小概率能获得。

scripts.text: I enjoy gathering shells from the sea. It's really fun and relaxing~
scripts.translation: 我喜欢从海里捡贝壳。这真的很有趣，也很放松~

scripts.text: When you see bubbles popping up from the sand or muddy puddles, try digging into the ground a bit. You might find some shells underneath the ground!
scripts.translation: 当你看到沙子或泥坑里冒出气泡时，试着挖一下地面。你可能会在地下发现一些贝壳！

scripts.text: It's usually seen at the beach near the west province of Prontera. If you ever try attacking it without being prepared, you might be in trouble.
scripts.translation: 它们通常出现在普隆德拉西部的海滩附近。如果你没做准备就贸然攻击，可能会陷入困境。

scripts.text: Al De Baran is known world wide as the City of Canals. The waterways really add a sophisticated, romantic touch to our fair city.
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰以“运河之城”闻名于世。水道为我们的城市增添了一份精致与浪漫。

scripts.text: Well, a canal is an artificial waterway used for travel,
scripts.translation: 嗯，运河是用于交通、航运或灌溉

scripts.text: However, the canals over here are just for show. If we needed to transport anything, we just use the Kafra Corporation Teleport service!
scripts.translation: 不过，这里的运河主要是为了观赏。如果需要运输东西，我们直接使用卡普拉公司的瞬间移动服务！

scripts.text: I have that you will enjoy your stay in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 希望您能享受在艾尔帕兰的时光。

scripts.text: Both of those places are tough
To arrive here from Prontera or Geffen, you've got to cross the Mjolnir Mountains.
scripts.translation: 要从普隆德拉或吉芬来到这里，必须穿越雷神之锤山。

scripts.text: If you've made it here by foot without using the Kafra Teleportation service,
scripts.translation: 没用卡普拉的瞬间移动服务，靠双脚走到这里？那可真

scripts.text: The Mjolnir Mountains are really steep, and it's full of aggressive and hostile monsters. So it's always a risk to travel through there alone.
scripts.translation: 雷神之锤山非常陡峭，且充满了具有攻击性的敌对魔物。因此，独自穿越那里总是充满风险。

scripts.text: If you wish to visit Alberta or the city of Payon, you must first travel through the Payon Forest.
scripts.translation: 如果你想前往艾尔贝塔或斐扬城，必须先穿越斐扬树林。

scripts.text: The Payon Forest is a winding, intricate maze where it's easy to get lost. Unless you concentrate and keep track of your path, you might be stuck wandering in that dangerous place.
scripts.translation: 斐扬树林就像错综复杂的迷宫，很容易迷路。要是不留心记住路线，就可能困在那片危险的森林里。

scripts.text: Payon, the Archer Village, was built deep inside this steep and rugged forest so that it may be protected from outside invaders. So I guess that a good decision on their part.
scripts.translation: 斐扬，即弓箭手村，建在这片陡峭崎岖的森林深处，以便抵御外敌入侵。所以我认为这是一个明智的决定。

scripts.text: The huge mountains surrounding this town
blocks people from outside to come into this town.
That may be a part of the reason how we have been able to
scripts.translation: 因此，我们才能不受外界影

scripts.text: keep this beautiful canal and mysterious alchemy
Some weapons or armor have Slots where you can insert Cards obtained from monsters.
scripts.translation: 一些武器或防具有插槽，可以插入从魔物身上获得的卡片。

scripts.text: Items dropped by monsters possess more Slots than ordinary weapons or armor sold in NPC shops.
scripts.translation: 魔物掉落的物品比NPC商店出售的普通武器或防具拥有更多的插槽。

scripts.text: I guess you can assume that an item with more Slots is more valuable than the same item with fewer Slots.
scripts.translation: 同一种装备，插槽越多，通常越值钱。

scripts.text: Once a Card is inserted into a Slot, it is impossible to remove it. So please be careful when you insert Cards into weapons or armor.
scripts.translation: 一旦卡片插入插槽，就无法取出。所以请在将卡片插入武器或防具时务必小心。

scripts.text: Also, when you mouse over equipment in the Item Window or Vending Window, the name of the item will be followed by the number of its Slots in brackets.
scripts.translation: 在物品窗口或露天商店窗口中，把鼠标移到装备上，就能看到名称后方用方括号标出的插槽数量。

scripts.text: For example, a Shield with 1 Slot, when moused over, would display the name 'Shield [1].'
scripts.translation: 例如，一个拥有1个插槽的盾牌，当鼠标悬停在其上时，会显示名称“盾牌 [1]”。

scripts.text: You may also right-click an item, and check the Card Slot window below the item description window for the number of Slots.
scripts.translation: 你也可以右键点击物品，并在物品描述窗口下方的卡片插槽窗口中查看插槽数量。

scripts.text: Have you ever obtained a card from a monster?
scripts.translation: 你曾经从魔物身上获得过卡片吗？

scripts.text: Level 1 weapons, which are the lowest grade, need a metal named ^3355FFPhracon^000000 in order to be upgraded.
scripts.translation: 最低等级的1级武器需要一种名为强化武器金属-级数一的金属来精炼。 ^3355FF^000000
关于强化武器金属-级数一
强化武器金属-级数一的使用建议

scripts.text: Phracon is a pretty common metal and can be found all over the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation: 强化武器金属-级数一是一种相当常见的金属，在米德加尔特大陆各地都能找到。

scripts.text: Although it lacks the strength of other metals, it's easy to find and obtain. You can get Phracons by killing monsters or by buying them in Forging Shops in towns.
scripts.translation: 虽然它不如其他金属坚固，但很容易找到和获取。击杀魔物可能会掉落，也可以在城镇的锻造商店购买。

scripts.text: When you no longer need Phracons because you are using higher level weapons, you can sell them for some zeny!
scripts.translation: 换上更高等级的武器、不再需要强化武器金属-级数一时，还可以把它卖掉换些Zeny！

scripts.text: Well, I hear lots of monsters carry Phracons and will drop them once killed. Why don't you go hunting for them?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我听说很多魔物都带着强化武器金属-级数一，被击杀后就会掉落。不妨去猎杀几只看看？

scripts.text: It shouldn't be too difficult. Once I found a Phracon that dropped after killing a Bebe Savage! But if you're desperate, you can always buy them at the Forging Shop.
scripts.translation: 应该不难找。我有一次击杀贝贝野猪后，就捡到一块强化武器金属-级数一！如果急需，也可以去锻造商店买。
祝你找到强化武器金属-级数一！

scripts.text: Alchemists, one of the 2nd Jobs, are able to create items out of several materials using knowledge from the ancient age of Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 炼金术士是二转职业之一，他们能够利用艾尔帕兰古代的知识，使用多种材料制作物品。

scripts.text: Most people don't know that there was an oriental form of Alchemy that developed in Payon.
scripts.translation: 大多数人都不知道，斐扬曾发展出一种东方炼金术。

scripts.text: These Payon Alchemists were able to create Gold out of different materials. However, Payon Alchemy never advanced as much as the Alchemy in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 斐扬的炼金术士能用各种材料炼出黄金。不过，当地炼金术的发展始终不及艾尔帕兰。

scripts.text: Materials for Alchemy in Payon were scarce and interest in that field eventually waned. Now, you can only study Alchemy here in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 斐扬缺少炼金材料，人们的研究热情也渐渐消退。如今，只有艾尔帕兰还能学习炼金术。

scripts.text: Still, I can't help but wonder what secrets were lost after the Payon art of Alchemy disappeared from the face of the Earth...
scripts.translation: 不过，我还是很好奇，随着斐扬的炼金术失传，究竟有多少秘密也消失了...

scripts.text: Alchemists specialize in chemical research in order to create useful items out of various things.
scripts.translation: 炼金术士专精于化学研究，以便利用各种材料制作有用的物品。

scripts.text: I also hear that they create all sorts of Potions, and can even summon certain monsters! It seems that their studies have all sorts of nifty applications.
scripts.translation: 我还听说他们能制作各种药水，甚至能召唤特定的魔物！看来他们的研究有着各种巧妙的应用。

scripts.text: A while ago I went out for a walk toward Mt. Mjolnir with my pet Savage Bebe. His name is NukNuk!
scripts.translation: 不久前，我带着我的宠物贝贝野猪去雷神之锤山散步。它的名字叫努克努克！我们遭

scripts.text: We got attacked, but luckily we weren't hurt.
scripts.translation: 到了袭击，但幸运的是我们没有受伤。

scripts.text: I was walking up a narrow path, and out of the blue, a giant and ugly plant started to attack me and NukNuk!
scripts.translation: 我正沿着一条狭窄的小路走，突然，一株巨大而丑陋的植物开始攻击我和努克努克！

scripts.text: I was so surprised, so me and NukNuk had to run away. I threw rocks at it, but I don't think I hurt it. It must have been really strong!
scripts.translation: 我吓了一跳，赶紧和努克努克逃跑。我朝它扔石头，可好像根本没伤着它。它一定很强！

scripts.text: What really surprised me was the plant that attacked me was a huge flower with the face of a person! So, look out for those. They're dangerous!
scripts.translation: 最吓人的是，袭击我们的竟然是一朵长着人脸的巨花！千万小心，很危险的！

scripts.text: Even though people are fascinated by the scenic beauty of Mt. Mjolnir, it's full of dangerous monsters!
scripts.translation: 虽然人们都被雷神之锤山的风景迷住了，但那里到处都是危险的魔物！

scripts.text: There are Flowers, Insects, Bees, Butterflies and Moths that are big enough to kill you if you're not careful!
scripts.translation: 那里的花、昆虫、蜜蜂、蝴蝶和飞蛾都大得吓人，一不小心就可能丢命！

scripts.text: Then again, most of these monsters won't hurt you if you don't attack first. But some of them will attack you once they see you!
scripts.translation: 不过，多数魔物只要不招惹，就不会伤害你。也有些一见到人就会攻击！

scripts.text: By the way, where is my NukNuk...?
scripts.translation: 对了，我的努克努克在哪里...？

scripts.text: Even to a strong Swordman, the Insects or Mt. Mjolnir pose a considerable threat. You've got to know your enemy before engaging it in battle!
scripts.translation: 就连强壮的剑士，也不能小看雷神之锤山的昆虫。开战之前，先了解敌人！

scripts.text: Honey Bees, Butterflies and Moths seem like simple creatures, but that doesn't mean you should underestimate them.
scripts.translation: 蜜蜂、蝴蝶和飞蛾看着不起眼，可不能因此轻敌。

scripts.text: These Insects have evolved over time, and can counter attacks from threats like you adventurers!
scripts.translation: 这些昆虫经过漫长的进化，已经能反击你们冒险者这样的威胁！

scripts.text: There are also carnivorous Insects, such as praying Spiders, praying Mantises, and the millipede like Argiopes.
scripts.translation: 还有蜘蛛、螳螂和类似蜈蚣的艾吉欧蜈蚣等肉食性虫类。

scripts.text: These monsters have mutated and are too strong for a person at certain levels. You should especially watch out for Argiopes.
scripts.translation: 这些魔物发生了变异，等级不够的人很难应付。尤其要小心艾吉欧蜈蚣。

scripts.text: Luckily, their eyesight is pretty bad, so it won't notice you if you walk a safe distance away from it.
scripts.translation: 好在它们视力很差，只要保持安全距离，就不会被发现。

scripts.text: No matter how harmless and pretty insects are,
scripts.translation: 虫子看着再漂亮、再无害，

scripts.text: take heed to not touch them.
They are extremely strong unlike their innocent looking.
scripts.translation: 们外表温顺，实力却很强。千万

scripts.text: Don't belittle the livings in the Mt. Mjolnir.
scripts.translation: 别小看雷神之锤山的生物。

scripts.text: I came all the way here from Prontera because I heard the Kafra Main Office was somewhere here in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation: 我从普隆德拉一路来到这里，因为我听说卡普拉总部就在艾尔帕兰的某个地方。

scripts.text: It shouldn't be that hard to find, but I'm awful at following directions. I always get lost, no matter how hard I try!
scripts.translation: 按说不难找，可我方向感太差了。再怎么努力，还是会迷路！

scripts.text: If that wasn't bad enough, I left my Magnifiers back in Prontera, so now I have to find someone to help me with these weapons I've got to appraise!
scripts.translation: 更糟的是，我把放大镜落在普隆德拉了，只能找人帮忙鉴定这些武器！

scripts.text: Equipment that is dropped by monsters can't be equipped right away.
scripts.translation: 魔物掉落的装备不能立即装备。

scripts.text: If you right-click the equippable item in the Item Inventory, you'll see that it is Unidentified and that Appraisal is needed. What to do?
scripts.translation: 在物品栏里右键点击装备，会看到“未鉴定”的提示。需要鉴定，该怎么办呢？

scripts.text: Well, in that case, you've gotta use ^3355FF Magnifier^000000!
scripts.translation: 在这种情况下，你就必须使用放大镜了！ ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: Even without a Blacksmith, Alchemist or Merchant in your party, you can appraise your equipment! Of course, a Magnifier is consumed each time you use one...
scripts.translation: 即使你的队伍里没有铁匠、炼金术士或商人，你也可以鉴定你的装备！当然，每次使用都会消耗一个放大镜...

scripts.text: Was that a hint of sarcasm in your voice when you said that?
scripts.translation: ..你刚才说话的时候，语气里是不是带点讽刺？

scripts.text: Al De Baran is such a wonderful place with its romantic canals and classic architecture. I love nothing more than to stroll through this city with my beautiful girlfriend.
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰真是个美妙的地方，有着浪漫的运河和经典的建筑。我最喜欢和我的漂亮女朋友在这座城市里漫步了。

scripts.text: Is that so hard to believe?! Yeah, ask anyone! She really exists! Although, sometimes, just sometimes mind you, she gets too excited about weapons and armor.
scripts.translation: ..这么难相信吗？！不信你去问别人，她真的存在！不过，她偶尔会对武器和防具特别着迷。只是偶尔哦。

scripts.text: I mean, instead of enjoying a romantic dinner, she'll just go on about how equipment dropped from monsters is higher quality than those sold in shops...
scripts.translation: 明明在吃浪漫晚餐，她却滔滔不绝地讲，魔物掉落的装备比商店卖的品质好...

scripts.text: I mean, why should I care if equipment dropped by monsters tend to have more Slots?! I can't even kill a Poring!
scripts.translation: 魔物掉的装备插槽更多，关我什么事？！我连波利都打不过！

scripts.text: So, you don't think of me stupid, do you?
scripts.translation: 所以，你不觉得我很蠢，对吧？

scripts.text: The tempature here in Al De Baran is very cool, probably because of the waterways. Do you think the water in the canals is drinkable?
scripts.translation: 艾尔帕兰真凉爽，大概是因为这些水道吧。你说运河里的水能喝吗？

scripts.text: Well, it's too late for me, since I already drank some. Still, I'm a little worried...
scripts.translation: 不过，问也晚了，我已经喝了点。还是有点担心...

scripts.text: On one of my travels around Midgard, I've heard from a really high level Mage that physical attacks, or magic with Neutral Property, won't damage Spiritual Property monsters.
scripts.translation: 有次游历米德加尔特，我听一位等级很高的魔法师说，物理攻击和无属性魔法伤不到念属性魔物。

scripts.text: Maybe that advice will come in handy, now that you know that. Always remember the importance of the Properties of your skills and weapons when battling monsters.
scripts.translation: 记住这点，也许能派上用场。和魔物战斗时，别忘了留意技能和武器的属性。

scripts.text: On the other hand, the water I drank did taste pretty good. Hopefully it didn't have anything too weird in it...
scripts.translation: 话说回来，那水还挺好喝的。希望里面没什么奇怪的东西...

scripts.text: Well, that might be an exaggeration. After all, it's just me that's welcoming you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，这也许有点夸张了。毕竟，只有我在欢迎你。嘿，

scripts.text: Aren't we straying off topic a little bit? Ah, you must be one of those adventurers!
scripts.translation: .？我们是不是有点跑题了？啊，你一定是那种冒险者吧！

scripts.text: Can't get your mind off the job, eh? Alright, now there was some monster that I saw just recently...
scripts.translation: 真是放不下工作啊，是吧？好吧，最近确实有只魔物让我印象深刻...

scripts.text: Ah, now I remember! Just a few days ago, I saw a really interesting looking monster! It was a Poring with Angel's wings!

scripts.text: one of the senior Kafra Employees. The Kafra Corporation Service is always trying to satisfy 100 % of our customers' expectations.

scripts.text: Well, adventurers like yourself can place items into Kafra Storage, so that you don't have to carry all of your stuff around.
scripts.translation: 嗯，像您这样的冒险者可以将物品放入卡普拉仓库，这样您就不必随身携带所有东西了。

scripts.text: Now, the Kafra Storage Window is separated into three tabs into which items are automatically sorted.
scripts.translation: 现在，卡普拉仓库窗口分为三个标签页，物品会自动分类到其中。

scripts.text: The ^3355FFItem^000000, ^3355FFEquip^000000, and ^3355FFEtc^000000 tabs work just like the tabs in your character Item Inventory.
scripts.translation: 物品、装备和其他三个标签页，与角色物品栏的分类方式相同。 ^3355FF^000000^3355FF^000000^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: Multiple items of the same type will only take up one Slot in the Item and Etc. tabs. For example, 324 Jellopies would take up only one Slot, and 22 Red Potions would take another Slot.
scripts.translation: “物品”和“其他”标签页里，同类物品可以堆叠，只占一格。比如，324个杰勒比结晶占一格，22瓶红色药水再占一格。

scripts.text: However, in the Equip tab, each and every single item takes up its own Slot. I guess that's because each and every single equipment can be uniquely upgraded by forging or through Cards.
scripts.translation: 不过，“装备”标签页里的每件装备都单独占一格。毕竟，每件装备的精炼和插卡情况都可能不同。

scripts.text: There's a total of 300 Slots for all three item categories in the Kafra Storage, so it might be helpful to remember that.
scripts.translation: 仓库三个类别合计有300格，记住这一点会很有用。

scripts.text: Oh, I get that question all the time. '^CC0066Oh Blossom, how do you do it?^000000' Well...

scripts.text: Also, the Kafra girls alone can't teleport our customers. We just receive and process your teleportation request.
scripts.translation: 另外，仅靠卡普拉女孩们是无法传送顾客的。我们只是接收并处理您的传送请求。

scripts.text: Behind the scenes, skilled professionals and technicians are working 24 hours a day to ensure that you teleport quickly and safely to your destination.
scripts.translation: 在幕后，专业的技术人员全天候工作，确保您快速、安全地抵达目的地。

scripts.text: Anyway, I hope you enjoy your visit here in the Kafra Corporation Headquarters.
scripts.translation: 总之，祝您在卡普拉公司总部参观愉快。

scripts.text: Thank you for coming all the way to visit us at the Kafra Corporation Headquarters here in Al De Baran!
scripts.translation: 感谢您大老远来到艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总公司参观！

scripts.text: The Kafra Service is always behind our customers with a dependable reputation that has been established over five thousand, eight hundred years...
scripts.translation: 卡普拉服务始终支持着顾客，凭借五千八百年来积累的可靠信誉...

scripts.text: FIVE THOUSAND AND EIGHT HUNDRED YEARS?! THAT'S INSANE!
Arrrrghh! Shut up and listen! It took me a week to memorize all this! My memory isn't as good as the other Kafra Employees...!

scripts.text: As I was saying, the Kafra Corporation was founded eight thousand, five hundred years ago by, um, Emilio Alexander Kafra... Inventor of the word 'Kafra?'
scripts.translation: ...刚才说到，卡普拉公司是八千五百年前，由...嗯，埃米利奥·亚历山大·卡普拉创立的...他发明了“卡普拉”这个词？

scripts.text: He was a great man. He... Argh! I can't remember!

scripts.text: This can't be the right story! Five million, eight hundred years?! It's impossible!
scripts.translation: ..！肯定背错了！五百万零八百年？！怎么可能！

scripts.text: I was a member of the Kafra Garrison before joining the Kafra Service Team. My specialty was ^990000Magnum Break^000000, so if you know what's good for you, don't mess with me.
scripts.translation: 加入卡普拉服务团队之前，我可是卡普拉卫队的一员，最擅长怒爆。识相的话，就别惹我。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: I'm trying my best to live as quietly and as femininely as I can, so don't make me break your knuckles! You got it?!

scripts.text: That's great news to hear. We're always working hard to make sure that our customers are satisfied with the services that we provide.
scripts.translation: 了！听到这个好消息真让人开心。我们一直努力工作，以确保顾客对我们提供的服务感到满意。

scripts.text: The Kafra Corporation will always support Midgard's adventurers with our excellent services.
scripts.translation: 临~！卡普拉总公司将始终用优质的服务支持米德加尔特的冒险者。

scripts.text: I'm here to answer any of your questions regarding Kafra Corporations policies, as well as take note of any of your feedback.
scripts.translation: 我负责解答关于卡普拉总公司政策的问题，并记录您的任何反馈。

scripts.text: So, you'd like more details on our policies and eligibility for our services? What would you like me to explain?
scripts.translation: 您想了解公司的政策和使用服务的条件？需要我说明哪方面呢？

scripts.text: As you probably already know, our customers must have at least Basic Skill level 6 in order to use the Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation: 您可能已经知道，我们的顾客必须拥有至少6级的基本技能，才能使用卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text: As for the reason for this certain policy, we've had problems with young, fresh faced Novices that would put everything into their Storage.
scripts.translation: 至于制定这项政策的原因，我们曾遇到过一些年轻、初出茅庐的初心者，他们会把任何东西都放进仓库里。

scripts.text: Now you remember your days as a Novice. Everything was new and exciting, but zeny was scarce. Well, a lot of Novices would even put their weapons and armor in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation: 您一定记得自己当初作为初心者时的日子。一切都新鲜又令人兴奋，但Zeny却很少。很多初心者甚至会把武器和防具也放进卡普拉仓库。

scripts.text: However, by this time, they've already spent what little zeny they had to open their Storage. But they don't have enough to access their Storage again!
scripts.translation: 可打开仓库时，他们就花光了仅有的Zeny，没钱再开一次取回装备了！
